claim: The GraphSAGE supplement describes 20 randomly selected training PPI networks with at least 15,000 edges and four heldout networks with at least 35,000 edges, split two validation and two test.
limitation: The statement does not define the candidate universe, edge-count convention, whether heldout selection was random, or exact selection order.

claim: All 24 deposited GraphSAGE PPI components exactly match named OhmNet edgelists.
result: 24 of 24 edge multisets exact; zero missing or extra records; 818,716 records on both sides.
limitation: Exact immediate-source match does not identify the original selection script.

claim: The deposited split is incompatible with the published thresholds in the currently supplied OhmNet files under every ordinary edge-count convention tested.
result: Raw counts fail for astrocyte, basophil, and midbrain; basophil remains below 15,000 even under directed-arc counting.
limitation: A different historical release, preprocessing stage, or undocumented exception could reconcile the manuscript with the deposited split.

claim: The released test split has 99.3845% test-row GeneID overlap with training and a forensic GeneID-lookup micro-F1 of 0.9971784.
result: 5,490 of 5,524 test rows seen; 1,126 positive label cells missed.
source_basis: Recovered complete node-to-Entrez mapping and exact released label vectors.
limitation: This diagnostic uses recovered identities and is not the reported GraphSAGE model score.

claim: Within the fixed set of 24 deposited tissues, near-perfect lookup behavior is typical under alternative 20/2/2 allocations.
result: All 63,756 allocations evaluated; median F1 0.998563; 92.954% at least 0.99; 22.087% exactly 1.
limitation: This universe ignores the stated edge thresholds because no assignment of these 24 satisfies them.

claim: The released fixed-24 allocation is less leakage-favorable than most reallocations of the same tissues.
result: Released F1 at 30.989th percentile; 69.012% of allocations equal or exceed it.
limitation: Percentile applies only to the deposited-24 universe.

claim: Test-tissue identity dominates fixed-24 variation in lookup F1.
result: 97.337% of population variance lies between test pairs; 2.663% among validation choices within test pairs.
source_basis: Complete finite enumeration and variance decomposition.
limitation: Variance allocation is descriptive for this finite universe.

claim: The actual heart/kidney validation choice unusually reduces lookup coverage for the lung/midbrain test pair.
result: Eighth-lowest of 231 validation choices; 3.247th midrank percentile within the fixed test pair. Adding both validation layers to training raises F1 to 0.998854.
source_basis: Complete finite enumeration plus exact actual split calculation.
limitation: This is a counterfactual lookup calculation, not a retrained GraphSAGE experiment.

claim: Under raw-threshold sampling from all 144 released layers, lookup F1 remains highly concentrated near one but has a meaningful lower tail.
result: One million samples per procedure; mean 0.993390 to 0.993914, median 0.995031 to 0.995452, sampled minima about 0.92.
source_basis: Fixed-seed C++ sampling under two explicit selection orders.
limitation: The released split is not a member; observed minima are not proven global minima.

claim: The released F1 is moderately high, but not exceptional, relative to all-144 raw-threshold counterfactuals.
result: 66.566th to 69.437th contextual percentile; 30.563% to 33.434% of samples equal or exceed it.
source_basis: One million samples per explicit selection procedure.
limitation: External percentile only because the actual split violates the current thresholds.

claim: The 144 edgelists comprise exactly 107 hierarchy-leaf networks and 37 internal-hierarchy networks.
result: Every network name maps uniquely to the 219-node supplied hierarchy.
limitation: The intended release semantics of the 37 internal files are inferred from their hierarchy positions, not separately documented in the README.

claim: GraphSAGE selected 10 internal hierarchy layers, including nine in training.
result: 14 selected leaf layers and 10 internal layers; kidney is the remaining internal validation layer.
source_basis: Exact 24-graph topology match plus hierarchy mapping.
limitation: The historical reason for including internal layers is unknown.

claim: Every released network-file ancestor-descendant pair has exact descendant-to-ancestor node and edge containment.
result: 167 of 167 pairs pass both node-set and edge-set subset tests.
source_basis: Direct set comparisons on supplied edgelists and hierarchy.
limitation: Internal layers are not exact unions of descendant leaves; they contain additional edges.

claim: The complete midbrain test network is contained in the training brain network.
result: Midbrain is a hierarchy descendant of brain; all midbrain nodes and edges are subsets of brain; all 2,310 test rows are seen in training.
source_basis: Exact hierarchy, topology, and Entrez mapping comparisons.
limitation: The GraphSAGE release represents them as separate graph components, so this is biological/topological containment rather than shared anonymous node IDs.

claim: Hierarchy similarity is only a weak and inconsistent proxy for train-test GeneID overlap and lookup F1.
result: Across all network pairs, WUP-vs-Jaccard Spearman rho 0.185; in all-144 samples F1-vs-mean-WUP rho 0.105 to 0.117, while F1-vs-row-overlap rho about 0.994.
source_basis: Complete pairwise network comparison and one-million-split samples.
limitation: Correlation depends on the candidate universe; it should not be interpreted causally.

claim: Restricting candidate networks to the 107 hierarchy leaves lowers expected lookup F1 relative to using all 144 layers.
result: Leaf-only means 0.987703 to 0.989842 versus all-144 means 0.993390 to 0.993914; actual external percentile 89.752nd to 92.914th.
source_basis: One million fixed-seed samples per procedure.
limitation: The actual split is not a member because it contains 10 internal layers.

claim: More internal hierarchy layers in training are associated with higher identity coverage for the fixed actual heldouts.
result: Expected internal count 6.927; actual count 9 at 85.35th percentile; mean F1 rises from 0.992952 at 4 internal layers to 0.995625 at 9 and 0.995952 at 10.
source_basis: One million random raw-threshold training sets with actual heldouts fixed.
limitation: Internal-layer count is confounded with network size and tissue identity; association is not a controlled causal effect.

claim: Extending the recovered 121-label transformation to 209 OhmNet-only genes does not drive the principal simulated F1 conclusions.
result: Zeroing positive-label weights for those 209 genes changes mean F1 by about +0.00070 under both primary procedures.
source_basis: Recovered exact GraphSAGE label transformation plus matched-split sensitivity.
limitation: Labels for the 209 genes are not validated against a deposited GraphSAGE target.

claim: The original graph-selection history remains unidentified.
result: Multiple candidate universes and selection orders are observationally plausible, but none literally yields the deposited split from current threshold pools.
source_basis: Synthesis of manuscript wording and data-level audit.
limitation: Would require historical preprocessing code, an older source release, or contemporaneous records to resolve.
